On Wednesday morning we visit **Teledyne Gavia** in Kópavogur, which builds the Gavia autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). The visit includes a presentation and a field demonstration of the AUV.

## Getting there

Participants travel **by their own transport**. There is also a **Hafró car** with a few free seats. If you need a lift, tell Teresa or Sigurður before Wednesday morning, and meet at the MFRI main entrance at 10:15.

If you drive yourself, you can also go straight to Teledyne Gavia, but let us know so we don't wait for you at the entrance.

## Bring

- Warm, waterproof clothes. Part of the demonstration is outdoors by the sea.
- Sturdy shoes.
